question: The value of ((x-y)³+(y-z)³+(z-x)³)/(6(x-y)(y-z)(z-x)), where x ≠ y ≠ z, is equal to:
solution:
**Calculations:**

According to the question,

(x - y) + (y - z) + (z - x) = 0

So, (x - y)³ + (y - z)³ + (z - x)³ = 3(x - y)(y - z)(z - x)

Now, ((x-y)³+(y-z)³+(z-x)³)/(6(x-y)(y-z)(z-x))

⇒ 3(x - y)(y - z)(z - x)/6(x - y)(y - z)(z - x)

⇒ 3/6

⇒ 1/2

**Hence, The Required value is 1/2.**
